scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ValoraWebApplicationDesign && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try { if(fs.existsSync('ValoraWebApplicationDesign/dist')) fs.cpSync('ValoraWebApplicationDesign/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); } catch(e){} try { if(fs.existsSync('dist') && !fs.existsSync('ValoraWebApplicationDesign/dist')) fs.cpSync('dist', 'ValoraWebApplicationDesign/dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); } catch(e){}"
